title: PointNeXt Adapter Improved Model for BIM Component Defect Association under Construction Images and Design Model Attributes
abstract: arXiv:2611.28820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Construction site defect analysis increasingly requires linking field evidence to the correct BIM object, because a crack, spalling area, missing sleeve or misaligned support is useful for quality control only when it is connected with component identity, location, responsibility and design intent. This paper proposes a PointNeXt Adapter improved model for BIM component defect association under construction images and design model attributes. The method aligns site image crops, local point cloud patches, BIM component identifiers, geometry attributes, material categories, installation stage, inspection distance, viewpoint quality and source reliability tags into component level inspection windows. PointNeXt learns local geometry and deviation from as built point evidence, while the adapter injects BIM attributes so the same geometric irregularity can be interpreted differently for structural, envelope, MEP and embedded components. translated_title: 基于施工图像与设计模型属性的BIM构件缺陷关联的PointNeXt适配器改进模型
translated_abstract: 施工现场缺陷分析越来越需要将现场证据与正确的BIM对象关联起来，因为裂缝、剥落区域、缺失套管或错位支撑等缺陷，只有与构件身份、位置、责任方和设计意图相关联时，才对质量控制具有实际价值。本文提出了一种PointNeXt适配器改进模型，用于在施工图像与设计模型属性条件下实现BIM构件缺陷关联。该方法将现场图像裁剪区域、局部点云切片、BIM构件标识符、几何属性、材料类别、安装阶段、检查距离、视角质量以及来源可靠性标签等对齐到构件级检查窗口中。PointNeXt从实际建成的点云证据中学习局部几何特征及偏差，而适配器则注入BIM属性信息，使得同一几何不规则性在结构、围护、机电（MEP）和预埋构件中能够被差异化地解释。
tldr: 该论文提出一种PointNeXt适配器改进模型，通过将施工图像、点云证据与BIM构件属性融合，实现施工现场缺陷与正确BIM构件的自动关联，并使同一几何缺陷能依据构件类型（结构、围护、机电、预埋）被差异化解释。
